electric.title: EV acquisition tax relief: acquisitions through Dec 31, 2026
electric.stake: Under current law (Restriction of Special Local Taxation Act, Art. 66④) the relief covers acquisitions this year only. A government bill before the National Assembly would cut the cap to 0.7M KRW for acquisitions from 2027; if it does not pass, the relief ends. Check your delivery and registration dates.
electric.noStake: Another relief (multi-child, disability, etc.) is larger, so the end of the EV relief does not raise the tax for this car.
electric.ended: The EV relief deadline (Dec 31, 2026) has passed. The result above still applies the 1.4M KRW cap; under the government bill the cap is 0.7M KRW for acquisitions from 2027, so check what the law now says.

compact.title: Light car relief: acquisitions through Dec 31, 2027
compact.stake: Non-commercial light cars get up to 750,000 KRW off the acquisition tax (Art. 67①). Check for an extension for acquisitions from 2028.
compact.noStake: Another relief is larger, so the light car relief was not applied.
compact.ended: The light car relief deadline (Dec 31, 2027) has passed. The result above still includes it, so check whether the law was extended.

whatIs.title: What is the Car Tax Calculator?
whatIs.description: This tool accurately calculates all taxes incurred when purchasing a vehicle, including acquisition tax (registration tax was merged into it in 2011), bond purchase and registration license tax by vehicle type, purpose, and region. It automatically applies eco-vehicle discounts and multi-child family benefits.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Enter the vehicle price. Use the factory price for new cars or the actual transaction price for used cars.
Select vehicle type (sedan/compact/van/truck/motorcycle/EV), fuel type, and purpose (personal/commercial).
Select the registration region. Bond purchase rates vary by region.
Check applicable discount categories (multi-child family, disabled, veteran) to reflect tax benefits.
Results update as you type, showing acquisition tax, bonds, license tax and the total cost.

usageTips.title: Tips
items: Compact cars (1,000cc or less) qualify for acquisition tax discounts.
EVs get up to 1.4M KRW acquisition tax reduction through Dec 31, 2026 (the cap from 2027 depends on a bill still under review); apply within 60 days.
Multi-child families (3+ children under 18) may qualify for tax exemption.
Used car taxes may be based on standard assessed value rather than actual price.

items.q: How much is car registration tax?
items.a: For passenger cars, acquisition tax is 7% (personal use) or 4% (commercial). Compact cars get a reduced rate of 4% with additional discounts.

Through Dec 31, 2026, EVs get up to 1.4M KRW reduction in acquisition tax (Special Local Taxation Act Art. 66(4)); the cap from 2027 may change under a government bill pending in the National Assembly. The hybrid reduction ended in 2024.
A mandatory bond purchase when registering a vehicle. The rate varies by vehicle price, displacement, and region.
